title: 第200章 五行本源第199章 给我燃
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
“混沌寂灭？”
“我倒要看看，是谁寂灭谁！”
“给我破！”
当下，左丘辰暴喝一声，长剑脱手而出，逆着混沌寂灭光向天空中那只混沌天目射去....
此刻，所有人都震惊了。
萧飞收起了嬉皮笑脸之色。
易师额头汗水密布。
胖子则紧握手中的德字锤....
要知道，这是一场豪赌。
如果长剑被混沌寂灭光抹除，那么两人将再无余力抵挡，必死无疑。
但如果长剑能穿透混沌寂灭光，击中混沌天目，那么这第三重人劫，便能破....
唰！
顿时，五色长剑在混沌寂灭光中艰难地前行。
而剑尖处的五行法则被一层层剥去，透明剑意也被一丝丝侵蚀。
但是，长剑没有停！
速度虽慢，但方向正确！
嗤！
同时，长剑也在不断穿透混沌寂灭光。
砰砰砰！
接着，两股力量在剑尖处激烈交锋，迸发出的法则火花将半边天空都染成了五色与灰色交织的诡异颜色....

三尺、两尺、一尺。
此刻，长剑距离混沌天目越来越近，但剑身也越来越细。
原本擎天巨剑此刻只剩下了手指大小，剑尖处的五行法则几乎被磨尽，只剩下一缕最纯粹的剑意在支撑....
当然，那是慕容仙儿的无情道剑剑意，也是左丘辰燃烧八百层神魂本源换来的最后力量！
“破！”
顿时，左丘辰暴喝一声，那缕剑意在剑尖处猛然爆发。
嗤！
瞬间，剑意化作一道极细极亮的光丝，穿透了混沌寂灭光的最后阻隔，刺入了混沌天目的正中央....
同时，天空中，那只冷漠无情的混沌天目忽然定格了。
喀嚓！
数息后，一道细微的裂纹从瞳孔中央蔓延开来，然后是第二道，第三道....
随着裂纹越来越多，越来越密，最终遍布了整个天目。
此刻，远远看去，混沌天目就像一面被打碎的镜子，在所有人的注视下轰然碎裂....
content_en:
"Chaos and Nirvana?"
"I want to see who annihilates whom!"
"Break it for me!"
At that moment, Zuo Qiuchen shouted loudly, took out his long sword, and shot towards the Chaos Third Eye in the sky against the chaotic light of death...
At this moment, everyone was shocked.
Xiao Fei put away his playful smile.
Master Yi's forehead was covered with sweat.
The fat man clenched the German hammer in his hand...
You know, this is a big gamble.
If the long sword is wiped out by the chaotic annihilation light, then the two of them will no longer be able to resist it and will undoubtedly die.
But if the long sword can penetrate the chaotic light of silence and hit the third eye of chaos, then this third level of human calamity can be broken...
Uh-huh!
Suddenly, the five-color sword moved forward with difficulty in the chaotic light of death.
The Five Elements Law at the tip of the sword was peeled off layer by layer, and the transparent sword intention was also eroded in every trace.
However, the sword did not stop!
The speed is slow, but the direction is right!
laugh!
At the same time, the long sword is constantly penetrating the chaotic annihilation light.
Bang bang bang!
Then, the two forces clashed fiercely at the tip of the sword, and the sparks of law burst out, dyeing half of the sky into a strange color of five colors and gray...
Three feet, two feet, one foot.
At this moment, the long sword is getting closer and closer to the Chaos Third Eye, but the sword body is also getting thinner and thinner.
The original giant sword that holds the sky is now only the size of a finger. The Five Elements Law at the tip of the sword has almost been worn away, and only a wisp of the purest sword intention is left to support...
Of course, that was Murong Xianer's ruthless Dao Sword Intention, and it was also the final power that Zuo Qiuchen obtained by burning eight hundred layers of soul origin!
"Broken!"
Suddenly, Zuo Qiuchen shouted loudly, and the sword intent suddenly erupted at the tip of the sword.
laugh!
In an instant, the sword intention turned into an extremely thin and extremely bright light filament, penetrating the last barrier of the chaotic light of death, and piercing into the center of the chaotic third eye...
At the same time, in the sky, the indifferent Third Eye of Chaos suddenly froze.
Click!
After a few breaths, a tiny crack spread from the center of the pupil, then a second one, a third one...
As the cracks became more and more numerous and dense, they eventually spread throughout the Third Eye.
At this moment, looking from a distance, the Third Eye of Chaos is like a broken mirror, shattering under everyone's gaze...
